name: dez-commercial
description: Product-style commercial for Dez Aguila's portfolio, built with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render DezCommercial out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 --crf=18 && npm run finish
scripts.finish: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -profile:v high -level:v 4.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart ../docs/media/dez-commercial.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 36 -row-mt 1 -deadline good -cpu-used 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a libopus -b:a 128k ../docs/media/dez-commercial.webm
scripts.render:vertical: npm run music && remotion render DezCommercialVertical out/dez-commercial-vertical-raw.mp4 --crf=18 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/dez-commercial-vertical-raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 25 -preset slow -profile:v high -level:v 4.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart out/dez-commercial-vertical.mp4
